The [[Fersherid]] '''RPI Carrier''' was a type of [[Rocket pack/Legends|rocket pack]] that could carry up to 65 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and could go 80 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] vertically and 180 meters horizontally. It was sold by [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]].
